channel.description: Latest articles from The Lawrence Times (lawrencekstimes.com)

item.title: A Kansas nuclear engineering program is back and students are quickly signing up
item.description: This past semester, K-State relaunched the nuclear engineering major that it discontinued in 1996. It has already attracted more than 50 students. Continue reading ...

item.title: Looking ahead in Lawrence: Here are some key changes coming in 2026
item.description: From rec center access fees and some transit fares to the many key city positions changing hands and elected offices on voters' ballots, here are key things Lawrence folks should know going into 2026. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence City Commission to discuss new affordable housing policy draft
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will discuss an updated draft affordable housing policy aiming to increase development to meet community needs and clarify requirements for developers seeking city funds. Continue reading ...

item.title: Letter to the Times: A 3-point plan to achieve more accessible and affordable housing
item.description: "Local data … makes clear that Lawrence needs more housing that is both affordable and accessible," members of the Accessibility in Affordable Housing Workgroup write in this letter to the Times. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kaw Valley Almanac for Jan. 5-11, 2026
item.description: This cardinal brings a little color and entertainment to the new year. It's not too late to set up a bird feeder; it might take some time for the birds to find it, but word travels fast. Continue reading ...

item.title: City employee shoots, kills alleged intruder at Lawrence City Hall
item.description: An armed city employee shot and killed an alleged intruder Monday morning at Lawrence City Hall, according to police. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence Democrats take aim at Kansas Republican’s congressional seat
item.description: A pair of Democrats from Lawrence with personal grievances about the Trump administration are challenging incumbent Republican U.S. Rep. Tracey Mann for his 1st District seat. Continue reading ...

item.title: Letter to the Times: Lifting short-term rental cap could harm Lawrence residents
item.description: "The need for long-term rentals won't decrease because the World Cup is coming and the need for short-term rentals is increasing," Chris Flowers writes in this letter to the Times. Continue reading ...

item.title: Lawrence city commissioners to consider lifting short-term rental rules during World Cup
item.description: Lawrence city commissioners on Tuesday will consider temporarily lifting limits on how many short-term rentals property owners can hold, aiming to capitalize on the influx of people expected during the World Cup. Continue reading ...

item.title: Project partners hope new west Lawrence fire station improves response time, meshes with neighborhood
item.description: A public meeting about a new fire station coming to west Lawrence did not yet alleviate all neighbors’ concerns about the addition, but project partners said they have plans to address them. Continue reading ...
